description: Extracts namespace, normalizes toponyms, and adds timestamp

script.description: Normalize toponyms: store original as label, create toponym_id from normalized name
script.source: if (ctx.toponyms != null) { def validToponyms = []; def seen = new HashSet(); for (def t : ctx.toponyms) { def origId = t.toponym_id; if (origId == null || !origId.contains('@')) { continue; } int atPos = origId.lastIndexOf('@'); if (atPos <= 0) { continue; } def origName = origId.substring(0, atPos); def lang = origId.substring(atPos + 1); if (origName.length() == 0 || lang.length() == 0) { continue; } t.label = origName; def normalized = origName; int parenIdx = normalized.indexOf('('); if (parenIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, parenIdx); } int bracketIdx = normalized.indexOf('['); if (bracketIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, bracketIdx); } int braceIdx = normalized.indexOf('{'); if (braceIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, braceIdx); } int commaIdx = normalized.indexOf(','); if (commaIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, commaIdx); } int dashIdx = normalized.indexOf(' - '); if (dashIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, dashIdx); } int slashIdx = normalized.indexOf(' / '); if (slashIdx > 0) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, slashIdx); } normalized = normalized.trim(); if (normalized.length() < 2) { continue; } if (normalized.length() > 200) { normalized = normalized.substring(0, 200).trim(); } def newId = normalized + '@' + lang; if (seen.contains(newId)) { continue; } seen.add(newId); t.toponym_id = newId; validToponyms.add(t); } ctx.toponyms = validToponyms; }
